item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 19 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 19 #SLPRSD
Issued at 06:10 PM 11 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #OrientalMindoro(CityOfCalapan, Naujan, Victoria, Pola, Socorro), #CamarinesNorte(Paracale, Vinzons), #Masbate(PioV.Corpuz, Esperanza, Monreal, SanJacinto, SanFernando, Batuan, Cataingan, Placer), #Albay(Manito, CityOfLigao, PioDuran, Guinobatan) and #Marinduque(Mogpog) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Marinduque(Torrijos, SantaCruz), #NorthernSamar(Lavezares, Allen, Capul, SanVicente, Rosario, Victoria), #Sorsogon(Pilar, Donsol) and #Albay(Jovellar) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
